original: Use case: logo-brand. Create one production app icon for ArenaVoca, a sports watching and Spanish learning app spanning immersive VR and mobile, with football and Formula 1 so the symbol must not be a football or racing car. Square 1024 by 1024 raster master, full-bleed opaque solid warm ivory background #FFF9EF, no rounded outer corners (OS masks later). A single bold memorable cobalt blue #2148EF symbol centered in the middle 60 percent of the square: a smoothly rounded open oval arena viewed in slight perspective that also reads as a speech bubble, with one deliberate short speech tail on lower right. Inside the oval, one very simple warm coral #FF9988 triangular play shape pointing right, optically centered. Flat crisp graphic design with soft expressive curves, excellent legibility at tiny launcher sizes. Minimal, confident, friendly, coherent with Material 3 expressive and the existing Playmaker cobalt, coral and cream palette. Precise clean edges, restrained geometry, balanced silhouette, generous safe area. No words, letters, gradients, shadows, 3D, devices, faces, sports team logos, glow, texture, watermark, presentation board or alternate variants. Deliver only the icon artwork filling the square.
